data.name: Diniela
data.long_meaning: The name Diniela is of Hebrew origin, derived from the Hebrew name Daniel, which means 'God is my judge'. In the Bible, Daniel was a prophet and a wise interpreter of dreams, and his faith in God remained strong even during periods of exile in Babylon. The name Diniela can be interpreted as 'God's way, just as Yahweh', highlighting the importance of remaining faithful to God's ways in our own lives.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the importance of staying true to God's ways.
